bottle: a rigid bottle, carton or jug of liquid, held upright by its body
glass: a drinking glass, cup, mug or tumbler
scoop: a measuring scoop with a handle
cloth: something soft and deformable: a cloth, towel, rag, napkin or sponge
item: any other rigid, hand-sized loose thing: fruit, a lid, a utensil, a brush, a tool, a bucket, a box, a toy
fixed: something that is not picked up: the table, a wall, a shelf, a sink, an appliance, a bin, a plant pot in soil
substance: a material inside something else, not grasped on its own: paint, water, sand, crumbs, a spill
